description: Greater Mekong Subregion hydropower dams (2016) is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Electricity infrastructure, Electricity production, Energy, Environment and natural resources, Fisheries production. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, db_table, geojson, kml, shp. The portal shows 2022-02-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
